description: SECRET in the request of an action definition (ADR-0045, items 3 and 6): the formulas of a request are pure and may read the secrets the definition's connection declares, each by a text literal, as text. A secret is a value the host program supplies when the request is sent; it is no constant of the formula.

reject.reason: the connection declares no such secret
the name is a literal, so that the secrets a request reads are known when it is defined
a request is pure: every attempt sends the same request
